description: Current prices of one product in every Polish store TagDip tracks (with delivery cost where known), its price history (lowest price ever, last 30 days, average, weekly lowest prices for 12 weeks) and TagDip's own answer to "buy now or wait?" in Polish. Pass product_id from search_products, or the url of a product page. Documentation: https://tagdip.pl/ai

url.description: Instead of product_id: a tagdip.pl product page, or a product page of a Polish store TagDip tracks.

name: get_product_prices
title: Get prices and price history
